# Notre

> > Notre is a curated fashion and lifestyle retailer offering premium sneakers, apparel, accessories, and fragrances from contemporary and avant-garde brands.

Notre specializes in high-end streetwear, technical outerwear, designer footwear, and niche fragrances. The shop features collaborations and exclusive releases from brands like Nike, adidas, Arc'teryx, BYREDO, and emerging designers like 032c and Collina Strada.

## Key Topics

- Premium Sneakers
- Technical Outerwear
- Designer Fragrances
- Contemporary Streetwear
- Nike Collaborations
- Arc'teryx
- BYREDO Perfumes
- 032c Berlin
- HOKA Running Shoes
- Dr. Martens
- Akila Eyewear
- ASICS
- New Balance
- SALOMON ADVANCED
- Japanese Denim
